title: Phone pivots (P128): caller reputation
notes: Owned by batch p1-G06-1 (P128). Manual links only: V3LUM never fetches them. Phone values are PERSONAL_TYPES: privacy=true links render only for analyst-typed seeds of a case that opted in, and as text with 'opening sends <number> to <host>' at TLP:AMBER and above (A2, P311 cond 5-6). The off-by-default messaging links (wa.me, t.me; setting phone_messaging_links) and ABR Telecom's static Consulta Numero page (no URL parameter, CAPTCHA) are emitted by the pivots_phone module, not by this pack: the frozen pack schema has no setting gate and requires a placeholder.

links.label: spamcalls.net caller reports (user reports, unverified)
links.notes: User reports, unverified (P128 cond 1). {e164} = digits without '+': spamcalls.net decodes a literal '+' in the path as a space (verified 2026-11-26). A 410 'not (no longer) available' page means no reports. The page shows public per-number request counters: opening it from the analyst's browser is a lookup by that browser.
